sub_graphs.title: EIP-2537: BLS12-381 Precompile Execution Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution lifecycle of BLS12-381 precompile calls from invocation to result return

nodes.label: BLS Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: System state when a CALL/STATICCALL to a BLS precompile address (0x0b-0x11) is initiated

nodes.label: Decode Input Data
nodes.description: Parse and decode the input calldata according to the specific precompile's expected format

nodes.label: Input Data Decoded
nodes.description: Input data has been successfully parsed into expected components (points, scalars, field elements)

nodes.label: Validate Field Element Encoding
nodes.description: Verify that all Fp and Fp2 elements are valid: top 16 bytes zero, value < field modulus p

nodes.label: Validate Point On Curve
nodes.description: Verify that decoded G1/G2 points satisfy the curve equation (or are the point at infinity)

nodes.label: Validate Subgroup Membership
nodes.description: For MSM and pairing operations, verify points are in the correct subgroup via group_order * P = 0

nodes.label: Input Validation Passed
nodes.description: All input validation checks have passed, ready for cryptographic computation

nodes.label: Input Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed, precompile will return error

nodes.label: Execute Cryptographic Operation
nodes.description: Perform the requested BLS operation (add, MSM, pairing, map) on validated inputs

nodes.label: Result Computed
nodes.description: Cryptographic operation completed successfully, result ready for encoding

nodes.label: Encode Output Data
nodes.description: Serialize the result point or boolean into the canonical output format

nodes.label: Precompile Execution Success
nodes.description: Precompile returned successfully with encoded result data

nodes.label: Precompile Execution Error
nodes.description: Precompile failed and consumed all supplied gas

edges.label: EVM executes CALL to precompile address
Field elements valid, check curve membership
Point on curve, check subgroup (MSM/pairing only)

external_entities.name: EVM Execution Context
external_entities.description: The calling smart contract or transaction execution that invokes the BLS precompile

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2537: BLS Input Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the comprehensive input validation logic for BLS12-381 precompiles

nodes.label: Raw Input Bytes Received
nodes.description: Precompile has received raw calldata bytes for validation

nodes.label: Validate Input Length
nodes.description: Verify input length matches expected format (e.g., 256 bytes for G1ADD, variable for MSM)

nodes.label: Input Length Valid
nodes.description: Input length matches expected size for the operation

nodes.label: Input Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input length does not match expected format

nodes.label: Validate Fp Encoding
nodes.description: For 64-byte Fp elements: verify top 16 bytes are zero and value < field modulus p

nodes.label: Validate Fp2 Encoding
nodes.description: For 128-byte Fp2 elements: validate both c0 and c1 coefficients as valid Fp elements

nodes.label: Field Encoding Valid
nodes.description: All field elements are correctly encoded

nodes.label: Field Encoding Invalid
nodes.description: Field element encoding violation detected

nodes.label: Check Point at Infinity
nodes.description: Check if all-zero encoding indicates point at infinity

nodes.label: Verify Curve Equation
nodes.description: Verify point satisfies y^2 = x^3 + b (G1) or corresponding twisted curve equation (G2)

nodes.label: Point On Curve
nodes.description: Point coordinates satisfy the curve equation

nodes.label: Point Not On Curve
nodes.description: Point coordinates do not satisfy curve equation

nodes.label: Verify Subgroup Membership
nodes.description: Verify group_order * P = 0 using optimized subgroup check method

nodes.label: Point In Correct Subgroup
nodes.description: Point is verified to be in the prime-order subgroup

nodes.label: Point Not In Subgroup
nodes.description: Point is on curve but not in required subgroup

nodes.label: Check For Empty Input
nodes.description: For MSM and pairing: verify input is not empty (k > 0)

nodes.label: Input Not Empty
nodes.description: Variable-length operation has at least one input element

nodes.label: Input Empty Error
nodes.description: Empty input detected for operation requiring at least one element

edges.label: Value >= modulus or top bytes nonzero
Point does not satisfy curve equation
Input has at least one element

external_entities.name: EVM Calldata
external_entities.description: Raw calldata bytes passed to the precompile from EVM execution

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2537: BLS Gas Pricing Model
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas calculation mechanisms for BLS12-381 precompile operations

nodes.label: Gas Calculation Initiated
nodes.description: System begins calculating gas cost for the BLS operation

nodes.label: Identify Operation Type
nodes.description: Determine which precompile (G1ADD, G2ADD, G1MSM, G2MSM, PAIRING, MAP_FP, MAP_FP2)

nodes.label: Fixed Cost Operation
nodes.description: Operation has a fixed gas cost (G1ADD, G2ADD, MAP_FP_TO_G1, MAP_FP2_TO_G2)

nodes.label: Variable Cost Operation
nodes.description: Operation has variable gas cost based on input size (G1MSM, G2MSM, PAIRING)

nodes.label: Apply Fixed Gas Cost
nodes.description: Apply fixed cost: G1ADD=375, G2ADD=600, MAP_FP=5500, MAP_FP2=23800

nodes.label: Count Input Pairs
nodes.description: Determine k (number of point-scalar pairs for MSM, or point pairs for pairing)

nodes.label: Input Count Determined
nodes.description: The value k representing input size has been calculated

nodes.label: Lookup Discount Factor
nodes.description: For MSM: lookup discount from table based on k (ranges from 1000 at k=1 to 519 at k>=128)

nodes.label: Calculate MSM Gas
nodes.description: Compute (k * base_cost * discount) / 1000 where base is 12000 (G1) or 22500 (G2)

nodes.label: Calculate Pairing Gas
nodes.description: Compute 32600 * k + 37700 for pairing check

nodes.label: Gas Cost Computed
nodes.description: Final gas cost for the operation has been calculated

nodes.label: Deduct Gas From Available
nodes.description: Subtract computed gas cost from available gas

nodes.label: Sufficient Gas Available
nodes.description: Available gas exceeds or equals computed cost

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for operation, execution will fail

edges.label: Operation is G1ADD, G2ADD, MAP_FP, or MAP_FP2
Operation is G1MSM, G2MSM, or PAIRING

external_entities.name: EVM Gas Context
external_entities.description: The EVM execution context providing available gas and input data

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2537: BLS Security Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the security-critical aspects and trust boundaries for BLS precompile operations

nodes.label: Untrusted Input Received
nodes.description: Input from potentially malicious source (smart contract, user transaction)

nodes.label: Sanitize Input Data
nodes.description: Apply all validation rules to transform untrusted input to trusted input

nodes.label: Input Validated and Trusted
nodes.description: Input has passed all validation checks and is safe for cryptographic operations

nodes.label: Malformed Input Rejected
nodes.description: Input failed validation and was rejected

nodes.label: Execute Non-Constant-Time Operation
nodes.description: Execute cryptographic operation (note: NOT required to be constant-time per spec)

nodes.label: Timing Information Exposed
nodes.description: Operation execution time may leak information about inputs

nodes.label: Subgroup Check Prevents Invalid Point Attack
nodes.description: Verify subgroup membership to prevent attacks using points from wrong subgroup

nodes.label: Invalid Point Attack Blocked
nodes.description: Potential attack using non-subgroup points has been prevented

nodes.label: Addition Without Subgroup Check
nodes.description: G1ADD and G2ADD explicitly do NOT check subgroup membership

nodes.label: Gas Limit Prevents DoS
nodes.description: Gas metering ensures operations cannot run indefinitely

nodes.label: DoS Attack Mitigated
nodes.description: Resource exhaustion attack prevented by gas limits

external_entities.name: Calling Smart Contract
external_entities.description: Potentially malicious smart contract invoking BLS precompile

ambiguities.text: The specification states precompile 'IS NOT REQUIRED to perform all the operations using constant time algorithms' without defining which operations may or may not leak timing information.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all BLS operations may have timing-dependent execution, treating this as a potential side-channel risk for applications requiring timing attack resistance.

ambiguities.text: The 'optimized subgroup check method' is referenced but not specified in detail.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations use a mathematically equivalent method to verifying group_order * P = 0, potentially optimized for performance but cryptographically sound.

ambiguities.text: No explicit specification of behavior when gas provided is exactly equal to gas required (edge case).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM semantics where exactly equal gas allows execution to proceed.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLS12-381 curve parameters and cryptographic primitives are assumed to be secure and correctly implemented.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cryptographic vulnerabilities could compromise all applications relying on BLS signatures and pairings.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot exploit timing variations in precompile execution to extract secret information in a practical manner.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timing side-channel attacks could leak private keys or other sensitive cryptographic material.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas costs accurately reflect computational effort, preventing DoS through underpriced operations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced operations could enable denial-of-service attacks against nodes.

implicit_assumptions.description: Applications using G1ADD/G2ADD without subgroup checks understand the security implications.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Applications may accept invalid points that could break cryptographic security properties.
